name: amway-abo-wellness-ai
description: 암웨이 ABO 전용 웰니스 AI 비즈니스 & 웰니스 컨설턴트

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend --if-present && npm run test -w frontend --if-present
